title: CHAPTER SEVENTEEN. Faith's consequences: overview
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): From faith in Christ follow justification, sanctification, and peace belonging toward conscience. Here union and justification; sanctification and peace in ye chapters that follow. — CHAPTER SEVENTEEN. On ye consequences and effects belonging toward Christian faith: where on ye union belonging toward believers with God, and their evangelical justification.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER SEVENTEEN. On the consequences and effects of Christian faith: where on the union of believers with God, and their evangelical justification.
From faith in Christ follow justification, sanctification, and peace of conscience. Here union and justification; sanctification and peace in the chapters that follow.
source_text: CAPUT DECIMUM SEPTIMUM, De fidei Christianae consequentibus et effectis: ubi de unione fidelium cum Deo, eorumque iustificatione Euangelica. Sequitur ex fide in Christum iustificatio, sanctificatio, et pax conscientiae. Hic de unione et iustificatione; de sanctificatione et pace sequentibus capitibus.
